journal.ratingHint: How did the day go — 1 to 10
journal.dopamineHint: Click a square and note what made you happy today
journal.winsEmpty: Nothing yet — add the first one
journal.winPlaceholder: Add an item and press Enter
journal.calendarHint: Color is the day rating, the bar is the dopamine level

week.analysisHint: “Topic → takeaway” blocks: what mattered and what follows from it
week.empty: No review yet — add the first block
week.timeHint: End of the week — a good time to reflect
week.conclusionPlaceholder: What I learned, what to change

habits.emptyHint: Create the first one in “My habits”
habits.name: Name
habits.kindLocked: Type can't be changed: old check-ins depend on it
habits.deleteText: Check-ins and goals will be deleted, notes become general. This can't be undone — maybe archive instead?
habits.goalsHint: A reminder, not a strict plan: “run from Nov 1 to Nov 9”
habits.goalTitlePlaceholder: E.g. go to bed before 11 pm
habits.notePlaceholder: What did you notice? What did you learn?

add.title: New cards
add.placeholder: apple || яблоко || I eat an [apple] every day || #food
add.previewEmpty: Start typing on the left — cards will appear here
add.errorsTitle: Errors — these lines will not be saved
add.keptErrors: Lines with errors stayed in the editor — fix them and create again

help.title: Format
help.optional: Examples and groups are optional: “apple || яблоко” is already a card.
help.examples: Several examples — separated by <>, the highlighted word — in [brackets].
help.forms: Three verb forms — joined by _: go_went_gone.
help.tags: Groups — with or without #, separated by spaces or commas. Nested — with /: #travel/airport.
help.comments: Empty lines and lines starting with // are skipped.

add.exampleText:
// example — feel free to delete
apple || яблоко || I eat an [apple] every day <> An [apple] a day || #food #nouns
run || бежать || I [run] in the morning || #verbs
go_went_gone || идти || I [go] home <> I [went] home <> I have [gone] home || #verbs

groups.empty: No groups yet — add words with tags on the Cards tab
groups.select: Pick a group to see its words and analytics
groups.deleteBody: Words and training history stay — only the group itself is removed.
groups.name: Name
groups.nameHint: A single tag, as in input: no spaces or “/”
groups.moveHint: Unavailable: into the group itself, its subgroups, or deeper than three levels.
groups.dropRoot: Drop here — to the top level
groups.deleteSubtree: Delete them together with the group
groups.deleteBodyTree: Words and training history stay either way.
groups.treeHint: Drag a group onto another to put it inside; onto a row edge — next to it. Or “⋯” → “Move to…”.

words.deleteBody: The word and its answer history will be deleted permanently.
words.termHint: Three verb forms — joined by _: go_went_gone
words.examples: Examples — one per line, highlight in [brackets]
words.groups: Groups — separated by spaces or commas

training.noGroups: No groups yet — add words with tags on the Cards tab

en_ru.title: EN → RU
en_ru.desc: See the word — recall the translation

ru_en.title: RU → EN
ru_en.desc: See the translation — recall the word, all three forms for verbs

context.title: Context
context.desc: A sentence with a highlighted word — recall the meaning

training.freeHint: All words of the group, including the archive. Levels do not change.
training.nothingDue: Everything in this group is reviewed for today
training.nothingDueHint: You can practice freely — levels will not change.
training.promptTranslation: How do you say it in English?
training.promptSentence: What does the highlighted part mean?
training.finishBody: Answered cards count, the rest stay for later.

results.title: Session complete
results.freeNote: Free practice — levels did not change

first_archived_group.title: Topic closed
first_archived_group.desc: Archive every word of one group

settings.importHint: CSV or a JSON word list is added to your words. Full backup is in ⚙ → Data.
settings.restored: Backup restored: {words} words, {groups} groups, {sessions} sessions, {days} days, {habits} habits
settings.resetHint: Deletes words, groups, training history and achievements. Days, habits and settings stay.
settings.resetBody: This cannot be undone. You can download a backup first.
settings.isBackup: This is a backup file — restore it in ⚙ → Data.
settings.backupMoved: Full backup and restore are in ⚙ → Data

errors.network: Server is unreachable — is the app running?
errors.internal: Server error, see logs for details
errors.invalid_verb_forms: Verb forms: exactly three joined by “_”, e.g. go_went_gone
errors.duplicate_word: This word with this translation already exists
errors.word_not_in_session: Word is not in this session
errors.invalid_group_name: Group name is a single tag without spaces
errors.duplicate_group: A group with this name already exists
errors.invalid_csv: File does not look like CSV
errors.csv_missing_columns: CSV needs term and translation columns
errors.invalid_unit: Unit must be up to 20 characters
errors.duplicate_habit: A habit with this name already exists
errors.field_not_enabled: This habit doesn't track that field
errors.title_required: Write the goal text or pick a habit
errors.group_cycle: A group cannot go inside itself or its subgroup
errors.group_too_deep: At most three levels of nesting
errors.invalid_parent: No such group — reload the page
errors.invalid_group_path: Group path: parts separated by “/”, no empty parts or repeats, at most three
errors.group_path_conflict: A group from the path already lives elsewhere — fix the path or move the group
errors.invalid_type_name: Type name must be 1 to 40 characters
errors.duplicate_type: A type with this name already exists
errors.invalid_type: No such type — reload the page
errors.invalid_column: No such column — reload the page
errors.invalid_column_name: Column name must be 1 to 40 characters
errors.column_not_empty: The column has tasks — choose where to move them
errors.invalid_blocks: Size must be 1 to 40 blocks (20 hours)
errors.invalid_task: Could not reorder — reload the page
errors.task_not_leaf: This task has steps — it is done when all steps are done
errors.task_done: The task is already done — mark it undone first
errors.task_too_deep: Too deep: at most 10 levels of steps
errors.past_day: A past day cannot be changed
errors.invalid_day_bounds: Day start and end are half-hours, start before end
errors.plan_overlap: Plan items overlap in time — reload the page
errors.invalid_start: Start time is a half-hour and the task must fit into the day
errors.focus_active: A focus session is already running — finish it first
errors.invalid_phase: This action is not available now — reload the page
errors.invalid_set: Sets 1 to 50, reps from 1, weight a number or empty
errors.invalid_exercise_name: Exercise name must be 1 to 60 characters
errors.invalid_kcal: Kcal is a whole number from 0 to 20,000
errors.exercise_in_use: The exercise is used in workouts

globalSettings.languageHint: The RU / EN switch is also in the header.
globalSettings.backupHint: One JSON file with everything: English, days, weeks, habits, game, sport, settings.
globalSettings.restoreHint: Replaces the sections present in the file (an old backup without journal, habits or game leaves them alone).
globalSettings.notBackup: This isn't a backup file. Word lists (CSV/JSON) are imported in “English → Settings”.
globalSettings.resetAllHint: Deletes everything: words, groups, history, days, weeks, habits, goals, notes, game and sport. Settings stay.
globalSettings.resetAllBody: This can't be undone. Download a backup first.

game.title: Title
game.blocksHint: Blocks of 30 minutes: 2 = an hour, 6 = three hours
game.deleteText: The task will be deleted permanently.
game.noColumns: The board has no columns yet. Create the first one — e.g. “Inbox”.
game.moveLeft: To the column on the left
game.moveRight: To the column on the right
game.boardHint: Drag cards between columns. Without a mouse — use the buttons on a card.

settings.typesHint: Study, life, work… A type is a colored label on the card and a board filter.
settings.deleteTypeText: Tasks of this type stay — just without a type.
settings.deleteColumnMove: The column has tasks ({count}) — where should they go?
settings.deleteColumnOnly: This is the only column with tasks — create another one first so they have somewhere to go.

game.splitHint: Importance, deadline and type are copied from the task; you can change them per step later. Enter — next step.
game.graphHint: Click a node to open the task or step.
game.parentHint: This task has steps: its size is the sum of steps ({sum}); it is done when all steps are done.
game.deleteTreeText: The task will be deleted together with all its steps ({count}).

plan.title: Day plan
plan.overLimit: Over the day limit ({limit}) — don’t overload yourself
plan.empty: The plan is empty — take tasks from the suggestions on the right or “+ Any task”.
plan.emptyPast: Nothing was planned for this day.
plan.topEmpty: No open tasks — add them on the board.
plan.leftoversHint: From last week’s plans, still open.
plan.settingsHint: The day scale and how many hours of work are normal. Going over is highlighted, not forbidden.
plan.moveHint: Drag to any time. Drop onto another task to swap them. Keyboard: ↑ / ↓ — by half an hour.

focus.setupHint: Prepare your place and tick the ritual — then “Started”.
focus.setupOver: Setup time is over — time to start.
focus.noRitual: The ritual is empty — you can start right away.
focus.idleHint: Start a task from the day plan — with ▶ next to it or here.

confirmText.done: The task will be marked done; points are given for net work time.
confirmText.stopped: The task stays in progress; time and points are counted.
confirmText.abandoned: The session won’t go into statistics; the task stays as it was.

focus.ritualHint: A checklist before a task — one item per line. “Started” unlocks when everything is ticked.
focus.ritualPlaceholder:
Raised the desk
Poured water
Turned on Do Not Disturb

shop.hint: +1 point for every half hour of net focused work. Spend them on your own rewards.
shop.empty: No rewards yet — come up with the first one: “an episode”, “coffee out”…
shop.ledgerEmpty: Empty so far — start a focus session.
shop.dopamineFull: The day’s dopamine scale is already full
shop.dopamineFailed: Could not add to dopamine — the purchase went through
shop.title: Title
shop.priceHint: A point is half an hour of work: price 4 = two hours of focus.
shop.deleteText: Purchases stay in the history. If you may want it again — archive instead.

stats.noWork: No focus sessions in this period.
stats.triggersHint: Red is the share of “gave in”.

sport.title: Title
sport.exercisePlaceholder: Start typing — I’ll suggest past ones
sport.deleteText: The workout will be deleted with its exercises and sets.
sport.exercisesHint: The list fills itself from workouts; each row shows what you did last time.
sport.noExercises: No exercises yet — they will appear from the first workout.
sport.inUse: The exercise is used in workouts — cannot delete
sport.deleteExerciseText: The exercise will disappear from the list.
sport.averageHint: Averages are per workout, over those where the value is logged. Tonnage = sets × reps × weight.

food.hint: Rough numbers for the big picture. Burned is active kcal from the watch only, so no “balance”.
food.placeholder: What you ate — I’ll suggest past ones
food.empty: Nothing logged for this day yet.

stats.noKcal: No food or workout kcal in this period.
stats.hint: Per-workout averages count only workouts with the value; “eaten per day” — days with logged food. Click an exercise to see its progress.

progress.title: Progress: {name}
progress.empty: The exercise did not appear in the last six months.
